name: Sportsmen
description: The Sportsmen were a mid-1950s street gang based on Avenue D in the Lilian Wald Housing Projects on the Lower East Side of Manhattan, with turf spanning roughly 5th to 14th Street. Described as a predominantly Black gang, they were a brother club to the Politicians and rivals of the Forsyth Boys and the Dragons. They were active in violent incidents including a 1955 killing in the Bronx and a notable 1959 gang war with the Forsyth Boys that resulted in multiple deaths. Their symbol was a top hat, cane, and glove, an emblem later adopted by the Bachelors in the 1970s.
